event.summary: Removing the tmux driver ends old terminals and removes their restart scrollback
event.detail: Reviewed commit: 1ed482dde220452e424973faf38a5e1318986333. TLDR: Users upgrading with old tmux-backed sessions lose those running terminals and their retained screens; restarting them starts an empty terminal. Could-be-highest: yes, ending user-owned processes and losing retained output would ordinarily qualify. Suggested bucket: highest if contrary to the upgrade contract. Confidence: confirmed source and specification analysis; no runtime behavior observed. Proposed_drop: exact specification acceptance. SPEC.md:3004-3016 explicitly says: 'This release ends them: the first time a host’s supervisor of this release starts, it ends that tmux server, and with it everything that still ran in an old terminal, without needing a tmux program.' (The source uses a straight apostrophe in host's.) It also says: 'After an update to this release, Restart, Clone and Replace start such a session in a new, empty terminal.' SPEC_impl.md:2882-2889 states the running supervisor runs no tmux and its driver of old terminals is gone. The assigned patch removes TmuxDriver exports and the HISTORY_LIMIT/restart-seed invariant at tmux.rs parent lines 23-75; this is the specified retirement, not an independent defect in deleted code. Possible_cover: none; no coverage sources searched. Caveat: this candidate accepts only deliberate retirement and empty restart, not an accidental effect on sessions already in terminal hosts; replacement and cleanup callers still require source checking.
